THIS WRIT APPEAL HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 08.08.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 2024:KER:60245 W.A. NO. 2080 of 2023  3  JUDGMENT A. Muhamed Mustaque, Acg.C.J.
This appeal was preferred by the writ petitioner.

The matter is related to conducting of a Social Impact Assessment Study under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, for acquiring the land for the purpose of Sabarimala Greenfield Airport.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
There are several similar challenges before this Court in various writ petitions and this Court disposed of those writ petitions, and the judgment of which reads as follows:
"When the matter was taken up for consideration, the learned Advocate General upon instructions submitted that Government propose to withdraw the notifications issued under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act, 2013'), which is produced as Ext.P1 in WP(C) No.13659 of 2024 and as Ext.P43 in WP(C) No.13775 of 2024.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is also submitted by the learned Advocate General that the Government has taken a decision to conduct a fresh SIA study through a different agency, and therefore fresh notifications will be issued under Section 4(1) of the Act 2013, in place of Ext.P34 produced in WP(C) No.13775 of 2024.

In the light of the above, this writ appeal stands disposed of recording the stand of the Government that they are proposing to 2024:KER:60245 W.A. NO. 2080 of 2023 conduct a fresh Social Impact Assessment Study.
All other contentions raised in this matter are left open.
